FORTIGATE_REAL_LOG.raw_claim: sanitized real logs; raw bytes remain local

UNSW_NB15_BENCHMARK.feature_contract: UNSW_NB15 benchmark-specific; FortiGate 36-feature state not reused

governance.prior_test_visibility_limitation: The same official UNSW-NB15 TEST split was used in earlier fixed-stage evaluations; Stage 2.4E is not newly unseen at overall project level.

methodology_finding.statement: FortiGate labeling feasibility was investigated; precision-first labeling did not produce sufficient defensible ATTACK/BENIGN coverage for primary supervised evaluation. FortiGate therefore remained the real-log anomaly branch and UNSW-NB15 became the labeled benchmark branch. Weak labels were not forced into supervised evaluation.

stage_2_2_unsupervised.note: Preserved source terminology; not silently renamed to Average Precision.
